summary: E2E Automated Test Plan for Nanotrak (v2)

scenarios.title: Admin Authentication with Valid Credentials
scenarios.preconditions: User is on the login page ('/') unauthenticated.
scenarios.description: Verify that valid admin credentials allow successful sign in and redirection to the admin overview dashboard.

steps.expected_outcome: Login page with email and password inputs displayed
Email input contains admin@nanotrak.com
Password input is populated
Redirects to /admin/overview with user directory and catalog links

scenarios.expected_result: User logs in successfully and is redirected to /admin/overview displaying platform metrics.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if dashboard loads with status 200 and 'Admin NanoTrak' profile is visible; FAIL if login fails or stays on login screen.

scenarios.title: Admin Authentication Rejection with Invalid Credentials
scenarios.preconditions: User is on login page unauthenticated.
scenarios.description: Verify that signing in with invalid password rejects login and displays error notification without redirecting.

steps.expected_outcome: Login page is loaded
Email field contains valid user email
Password field contains invalid string 'WrongPassword123'
Validation/Authentication error message is shown

scenarios.expected_result: Authentication fails with an error message and user remains on login page.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if login is rejected with error feedback; FAIL if access to admin dashboard is granted.

scenarios.title: Admin Overview Dashboard Metrics and Refresh Functionality
scenarios.preconditions: User is logged in and on /admin/overview.
scenarios.description: Verify that the admin overview dashboard renders charts, engagement stats, and metrics correctly.

steps.expected_outcome: Overview dashboard is loaded
Headings 'FAN ENGAGEMENT DISTRIBUTION' and 'CELEBRITY SIGNING VOLUME' are present
Dashboard re-fetches latest telemetry and metrics seamlessly

scenarios.expected_result: Overview dashboard displays Fan Engagement Distribution and Celebrity Signing Volume.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if overview widgets render properly and Refresh Data updates dashboard without errors.

scenarios.title: Open Celebrity Onboarding Wizard Modal
scenarios.description: Verify opening the Celebrity Onboarding wizard modal from the Celebrities management directory.

steps.expected_outcome: Celebrity Management directory is displayed
Dropdown opens offering 'Celebrity Profile' and 'Hardware Pen'
Onboard Celebrity modal opens with input fields

scenarios.expected_result: Onboarding modal opens with multi-step celebrity registration form.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if 'ONBOARD CELEBRITY' form appears with first name, last name, email, and handle fields.

scenarios.title: Celebrity Onboarding Form Validation on Empty Submission
scenarios.preconditions: Celebrity Onboarding modal is open on /admin/celebrities.
scenarios.description: Verify validation handling when submitting an empty Celebrity Onboarding form on Step 1.

steps.expected_outcome: Celebrity management page loaded
Celebrity modal is opened
Onboarding modal displayed with blank inputs
Validation errors appear on required inputs; form does not advance

scenarios.expected_result: Form blocks progression to Step 2 and displays field validation errors for required inputs.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if wizard prevents advancing with empty fields; FAIL if step advances with null payload.

scenarios.title: Fans Directory Search and Real-time Filter
scenarios.description: Verify live search filtering in the Fans management directory.

steps.expected_outcome: Fans management page loads with table/cards
Search term is entered into filter input
Filtered results match search term or display empty state indicator

scenarios.expected_result: Fan list filters in real-time based on fan name, email, or location query.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if query filters items or shows appropriate empty state when no matching fan found.

scenarios.title: Verifier Directory Navigation and Actions Visibility
scenarios.description: Verify navigation and verifier list rendering in Verifier Management view.

steps.expected_outcome: Verifier Management page loads with title and actions
'Add Verifier' button and verifier search input are accessible

scenarios.expected_result: Verifier management directory renders search input and 'Add Verifier' button.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if verifier management page loads successfully with HTTP 200 and search input.

scenarios.title: Hardware Pens Catalog and Inventory Management View
scenarios.description: Verify navigation to Hardware Pens catalog and inventory management view.

steps.expected_outcome: Hardware pens inventory view loads successfully
Pens catalog list and status badges are rendered

scenarios.expected_result: Pens catalog renders hardware status, pairing statuses, and device identifiers.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if /admin/pens loads device table with battery, connection, and assignment data.

scenarios.title: Products Catalog Navigation and View
scenarios.description: Verify navigation to Products catalog and digital item management view.

steps.expected_outcome: Products view loads successfully
Product catalog list is displayed

scenarios.expected_result: Products management directory loads item list and digital twin records.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if /admin/products loads with 200 OK and product management controls.

scenarios.title: Support Center Ticket Management Queue View
scenarios.description: Verify Support Center ticket management dashboard loads active tickets.

steps.expected_outcome: Support Center dashboard is loaded
Ticket queue table/cards are displayed with status tags

scenarios.expected_result: Support Center page renders ticket management interface and resolution workflows.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if /admin/support-center displays support ticket queue and filtering tools.

scenarios.title: Autograph Verification Status Tracking View
scenarios.description: Verify Verification Status tracking view renders signature verification telemetry.

steps.expected_outcome: Verification Status tracking page loads
Verification status metrics and tracking entries are displayed

scenarios.expected_result: Status Tracking page displays ongoing and completed autograph verification pipeline states.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if /admin/verification-status loads with timeline and status metrics.

scenarios.title: 404 Error Handling for Invalid Admin Routes
scenarios.description: Verify application behavior when navigating to an invalid or non-existent route.

steps.expected_outcome: Page displays 404 Not Found state or falls back to admin overview safely
Navigation sidebar remains responsive and functional

scenarios.expected_result: Application gracefully displays a 404 page or redirects back to /admin/overview without crashing.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if application handles non-existent route gracefully without unhandled JS exceptions; FAIL if white-screen crash occurs.

scenarios.title: Search Filter Input Sanitization with Special Characters
scenarios.description: Verify search input behavior with special characters and SQL injection strings across admin directories.

steps.expected_outcome: Celebrity directory loaded
Input accepted safely without breaking DOM or network queries
Table displays no results or sanitized query indicator

scenarios.expected_result: Search fields sanitize inputs without rendering errors or breaking the UI.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria: PASS if UI sanitizes string and displays zero results cleanly without crashing.
